description: This file declares the CurrencyHttpClient class, which provides asynchronous methods to fetch currency metadata and ratios, and manages currency code and response language settings.

classes.name: CurrencyHttpClient
classes.description: A client class for fetching currency metadata and ratios asynchronously, with optional test override for web failure.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the client with source currency code and response language.

methods.name: GetCurrencyMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves currency metadata as a string.

methods.name: GetCurrencyRatiosAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves currency ratios as a string.
